description: Generate N structurally valid but value-diverse mocks from a Zod schema — for property-based testing. Use when generate_valid_mock is too deterministic and you need varied inputs to surface edge cases. Supply seed for reproducible output in CI.

count.description: Number of mock variants to generate (default: 5, max: 50)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output — omit for random variants each call

name: generate_mock_variants
